Frequently Asked Questions

How long does it take to make my Motorcycle Plates?
Most custom orders are produced within 24 hours (1 business day). Once your order is confirmed, we'll give you a precise ETA before we start.

Are Motorcycle Plates suitable for road use in Singapore?
Our standard prints are precision-engineered to meet strict OneMotoring dimensional standards (50mm H × 30mm W × 5mm) and are VEP/ANPR friendly - readable by the camera systems at customs and condominium gantries. Full custom dimensions or track-spec styling are strictly for off-road, show or display use.

How durable is it in Singapore's weather?
Built for daily driving - UV- and chemical-resistant coatings over 3mm laser-cut cast acrylic keep the characters sharp and fade-free through sun and rain.

How do I order Motorcycle Plates?
WhatsApp us at (+65) 8826 1189 with your registration number and preferred finish, or use the contact page - we'll confirm your specs and ETA before production.
